Contract ManageProductCatalogCRUDService::modifyProductCatalog(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		pc: ProductCatalog = ProductCatalog.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		pc.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		result = false or
		pc.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		pc.Name = name and
		result = true
}
